role: Independent evidence grading; never expose this file to provider adapters or coding agents

grading.supported: An independent reviewer must cite the exact returned evidence and check it against expected.json and the pinned source. A path or symbol name alone does not establish semantics. Structured and prose evidence receive identical treatment.
grading.complete: Every fact below is supported, no disqualifying contradiction remains, output is not clipped, and collection stayed within the frozen common budgets.
grading.negative: A complete exact-symbol search or equivalent provider result within the entire requested scope supports absence. A failed tool call, empty heuristic top-k, or unrelated positive result does not.
grading.provenance: Use declared source paths and lines, actual installed resolution paths plus package manifests/declarations, or complete raw source excerpts. A hash is useful but not mandatory if returned exact bytes match the pinned corpus.
grading.counts: Retrieval actions, bytes and backend latency remain separate from correctness. They are not actual agent tokens or task completion time.
grading.reviewLedger: For every fact record state, concise reason, raw artifact SHA256, response index or JSON pointer, and an exact evidence quote. Missing citations cannot be supported. Preserve contradictions even if a later fallback repairs them.

discovery-workspace-scan.requirement: Identify findWorkspacePackages in workspace/find-packages/src/index.ts with implementation evidence.
Show delegation to findWorkspacePackagesNoCheck and packageIsInstallable checks on each returned project, using supplied options plus default supported architectures.
Show unchecked includeRoot:true and exclusions **/node_modules/** and **/bower_components/**.
Show project roots sorted using lexCompare, not guessed filesystem order.

owning-configs.requirement: Source belongs to workspace/find-packages/tsconfig.json; rootDir src, outDir lib, matching src inclusion.
Test belongs to workspace/find-packages/test/tsconfig.json; rootDir dot, outDir ../test.lib, noEmit false, matching test inclusion.
Resolve extends through @pnpm/tsconfig and show composite true, declaration true, commonjs, node resolution, es2022 and strict true. Showing the full config chain also qualifies.

Source references cli/cli-utils, fs/find-packages, packages/constants, packages/logger, packages/types, workspace/read-manifest. Test references its parent source project. Equivalent normalized paths qualify.

alias-api-old.requirement: The supplied consumer's execa import resolves to safe-execa 0.1.2; distinguish alias from installed identity and provide actual declaration provenance.
No named type export execa exists. Complete module exports or complete declaration file supports absence; an unrelated package export does not.

alias-api-new.requirement: The supplied consumer's safe-execa import resolves to safe-execa 0.1.4 with actual declaration provenance.
Named type export execa exists, supported by export type { execa } or the equivalent checked symbol.

transitive-cache-api.requirement: npm-resolver's direct lru-cache import resolves to 10.4.3; show its actual installed edge.
10.4.3 has named LRUCache constructor and ttl expiry option, with API/source evidence.
Git resolver imports hosted-git-info alias to @pnpm/hosted-git-info 1.0.0, whose internal require resolves lru-cache 6.0.0. Show both actual installed edges.
6.0.0 exports a CommonJS constructor and supports maxAge; do not claim it is a second direct workspace import.

scoped-selector-parser.requirement: Locate parsePackageSelector in workspace/filter-workspace-packages/src/parsePackageSelector.ts within workspace scope.
Show trailing ... means dependencies, leading ... means dependents, adjacent ^ sets excludeSelf, and returned includeDependencies/includeDependents/excludeSelf fields.

Show parentDir derived from prefix plus selected directory and namePattern returned separately. Plain relative location and brace location handling must be visible; parser is distinct from graph expansion.

direct-workspace-imports.requirement: Exactly the nine production import sites in expected.json, with the named export and local alias. All happen to retain localName findWorkspacePackages. No tests, declarations, transitive or other-package names counted.
Each site has an import statement excerpt or equivalent checked import binding evidence, not nine path mentions alone.

declared-dependent-impact.requirement: Exactly @pnpm/package-is-installable and @pnpm/plugin-commands-env; locations config/package-is-installable and env/plugin-commands-env.
Show each package.json production dependency declaration on @pnpm/env.system-node-version and establish a complete manifest-scope scan, excluding development and transitive relations.

scope-negative.requirement: No production definition of exact getAuthHeadersFromConfig within workspace. Complete scoped source evidence required.
Do not count network/auth-header/src/getAuthHeadersFromConfig.ts as satisfying workspace scope; mentioning it explicitly as out of scope is allowed.

missing-symbol.requirement: No exact production export findWorkspacePackagesRecursive in repository scope, supported by complete scoped evidence.
Any similarly named findWorkspacePackages suggestion remains clearly separate from an exact match.

ambiguous-handler.requirement: Explicitly retain ambiguity; the unqualified name does not identify one definition.
Show at least two genuine handler production definitions from different packages, drawn from expected.json, with implementation/definition evidence.
Indicate needed package/file/command context or present candidates for selection; do not silently choose one.

freshness-concurrency.requirement: Initial and both warm queries show cap4 and Math.min(MaxDefaultWorkspaceConcurrency,getAvailableParallelism(cache)) in the current production source.
After coordinator mutation, final usable answer shows cap7 with unchanged formula and current source provenance within deadline. Report stale/pending interim results explicitly.
Charge time from mutation completion, including500ms common grace, refresh, wait and usable query. Do not substitute an unmeasured reindex or drop failed refresh attempts.
